title: Microservices: the big picture
context: Decomposing a monolith into independently deployable services.
fact: Netflix runs on hundreds of microservices, each owned by a small team.

title: API gateways & service discovery
context: Routing, discovery, and edge concerns in microservices.
fact: An API gateway gives clients one entry point to many services.

title: Event-driven messaging
fact: Event-driven systems trade immediate consistency for looser coupling.

title: Data per service & sagas
context: Database-per-service and saga pattern for distributed transactions.
fact: Each service owning its database avoids shared-schema coupling.

title: Resilience patterns
fact: A circuit breaker stops calling a failing service so it can recover.

title: Observability
context: Tracing, metrics, and logs across services.
fact: Distributed tracing follows one request across every service it touches.
